name: Mont-Dore
description: 42km of pistes, 11 lifts, at the base of Puy de Sancy (1,885m) — the highest peak in the Massif Central. Historic Belle Époque thermal spa town with grand hotels and the Thermes du Mont-Dore sulphur springs. Val de Courre ski area above town. Good for families, spa-seekers.
